text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――10th one finished! 
Huu-……Trainer-san, how's my time……?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, maybe it's because Trainer-san 
is standing at the goal? Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Anyways! With this, we're done for today,
right!? 
And so……after this, are you free?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You see,
I'm part of the committee for the Test of
Courage event! 
And, today I'm going to be making the final
checks on the course.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san,
could you do a trial run of the course? 
And if you could tell me your thoughts,
I'd be really glad!

So I'd be previewing the Test of
Courage…… 
Since she was so hard working and
positive, 
this might be a good opportunity to help
her out.
choice_data_list: If you're fine with me, sure!
If you're fine with me, sure!

text_block_list.text:
――And so,
we made our way to the starting point of
the Test of Courage.
A student was already there to act as a
guide.

text_block_list.name: Guide-role Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Just go straight down this path.
Place this candle-shaped light 
at the shrine near the goal to clear the test.
Good luck out there!

There was an eerie sound of dripping water
coming 
from somewhere……it sent a chill down my
spine……
(Drip)

Suddenly,
something cold fell on my back!
Water maybe……? 
At least, I really hope it's just water……!

The visibility was poor and it made me
hesitate 
to move forward……I could feel my heartbeat
getting 
louder. But, I need to keep moving――

(Tap……tap……――click, click……step, step,
step――)
Ah……Aaah, Aaaaaaaahhh~~~……!
(Step step step step step! ――Pull!)
――――Ahaa, did I scare you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's me, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear……the goal is right ahead though―― 
……shall we go together?

I was struggling to get my heartbeat under
control…… 
but Sakura Laurel led me and we soon arrived
at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here's the goal! 
Good job out there! So, how was it?

Each of the scares was timed perfectly,
but Sakura 
Laurel's role as the ghost was the most
terrifying――

While I was giving my thoughts,
she had suddenly disappeared. 
……Was she trying to scare me again?
choice_data_list: Laurel, you won't get me again――

text_block_list.text: (――Grip!)

Something grabbed my arm and pulled 
me with a tremendous force――
(Rustle rustle rustle――!)

Weren't we supposed to already be at the
goal!? 
I was being dragged through the dark,
confused and scared with no idea what was
happening――
Fufuu♪
――Suddenly I could see again.

Tadaa! 
It's beautiful isn't it, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Did I scare you? 
My surprise was a big success then, huh♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: My gratitude towards Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's a special scenery that I found―― 
and I wanted to show it to Trainer-san
first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Do you like it?

I couldn't think of why she was that
grateful. 
Today,
all I did was help with her Test of
Courage――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, you were scared through and through,
huh♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――But because you're like that,
you're really helping me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Like earlier, when we went out together――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san,
you were really interested in all the
things I loved.
You were having fun just listening to me
talk――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And when you said French cuisine was like
magic―― 
I was surprised.
Because……I believe that too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Today was like that too.
The Test of Courage course that 
I made, you challenged it head-on,
and got scared by it――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The Test of Courage will be a great
success! 
I'm convinced of that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And also――do you remember? 
When there was some trouble with the gym
equipment?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
At that time, you said it right? 
My positivity is what made sure everything
went so well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But, the reason I can keep running with that
positivity――
『I can help with that! Let's do it!』
『I can help with that! Let's do it!』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Is because……Trainer-san is always there, 
working hard to support me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why……I can keep running forward. 
Because Trainer-san is with me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……and that part of you reminds me of my
dad.

With a giggle,
she turned to look up at the sky.
As she said, 
this was special,
there was a spectacular view of the sky.

The night sky was lit up by the brilliant
stars. 
But to me,
there was something that shined brighter――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――I can still keep getting stronger.

Sakura Laurel declared that silently,
but with conviction. 
There was true belief reflected in those
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ――Because I have you.

She was radiant――Brighter, stronger,
and more 
dazzling than anyone……――As a trainer,
I wanted 
to continue to support a girl that
brilliant.
